title: Senhaja de Srair language
displaytitle: Senhaja de Srair language

titles.display: Senhaja de Srair language

extract: Senhaja de Srair or Senhaja Berber, is a Northern Berber language spoken by the Senhaja de Srair inhabiting the central part of the Moroccan Rif. It is primarily spoken in the districts of Targuist, Ketama, and Bni Boufrah, west of the Tarifit-speaking area in eastern Rif, by approximately 85,000 speakers.
